n_rows.derivation: Explicit task/author scenario parameter, not inferred from target outcomes.

margins.derivation: Rural Malawi geometric means; log_sd=sqrt(log(1+(SD/mean)^2)); lipid arithmetic anchor=GM*exp(log_sd^2/2). Individual CVs from Navrongo, never CI-derived.

hdl_bmi_effects.derivation: Table4 BMI category contrasts relative to18.5-<25; initial model constant within categories.

tc_bmi_working_slope.derivation: Assumed Gaussian copula rho=2*sin(pi*Spearman/6); lognormal r=(exp(rho*sx*sy)-1)/sqrt(expm1(sx^2)*expm1(sy^2)); working slope=r*0.92/3.61. Conditional transfer unobserved. Sensitivity substitutes the urban Ashanti rank component; remaining margins and law held fixed. No target mixture probability is inferred.

reference_age.derivation: Explicit task/author scenario parameter, not inferred from target outcomes.

hdl_bmi_cutpoints.derivation: Table4 BMI category contrasts relative to18.5-<25; initial model constant within categories.

tc_age_working_slope.derivation: Author-assumed0.008 mmol/L/year; no observed TC age coefficient.

hdl_age_center.derivation: Table4 age contrasts; subtract0.04 for age34 anchor. Source adjustment/selection not reconstructed.

hdl_age_cutpoints.derivation: Table4 age contrasts; subtract0.04 for age34 anchor. Source adjustment/selection not reconstructed.

age_bmi_latent_correlation.derivation: Assumed weak latent correlation0.15; unidentified by evidence.

age_quantiles.derivation: Reported rural Malawi quartiles/median plus assumed18/90 endpoints and linear inverse-CDF interpolation.

residual_latent_correlation.derivation: Convert ranks to lognormal Pearson under assumed margins; partial r=(rTH-rBT*rBH)/sqrt((1-rBT^2)*(1-rBH^2)); invert lognormal correlation. Source does not adjust age/sex. Sensitivity substitutes the urban Ashanti rank component; remaining margins and law held fixed. No target mixture probability is inferred.

female_probability.derivation: Explicit task/author scenario parameter, not inferred from target outcomes.

hdl_age_effects.derivation: Table4 age contrasts; subtract0.04 for age34 anchor. Source adjustment/selection not reconstructed.

reference_bmi.derivation: Explicit task/author scenario parameter, not inferred from target outcomes.

lipid_residual_log_sd.derivation: Pooled Navrongo lipid CV converted to log_sd=sqrt(log(1+CV^2)); conditional residual CV transfer is approximate.

age_probabilities.derivation: Explicit task/author scenario parameter, not inferred from target outcomes.

assumptions.description: External selection, population and assay differ. Synthetic exploratory scenario only; no source reconstruction or validated target transfer.
F probability0.5; rural Malawi age quartiles interpolated with endpoints18/90. Target composition unknown. F/M mapped to source women/men by assumption.
Lognormal BMI and lipid shocks. Navrongo individual CVs transferred, not source CIs. Assumed latent age/BMI correlation0.15 is unidentified.

A trivariate lognormal law maps Ashanti urban ranks and Navrongo moments to a working raw BMI-TC slope, transferred conditionally after age/sex adjustment. Unobserved confounding/shape bridge. TC age slope0.008 is an author scenario, not a reported TC coefficient.

Tanzania/Uganda categorical HDL-BMI/age contrasts enter an additive conditional mean. Source stratum/additional covariates absent. Category evidence does not identify within-category gradients/interactions.

Partial BMI out of the assumed trivariate lognormal source law, then map the resulting correlation to multiplicative lipid residual shocks. This is not observed target residual dependence. Source total CVs reused as conditional residual CVs, so total variation may increase. This sensitivity uses urban Ashanti ranks with unchanged rural Malawi margin anchors; it is not an urban source-population reconstruction.
Positive recorded mmol/L values; no calibrated assay error/bridge. Do not remove HDL>TC rows. Factor38.67 changes numeric units only.

Greiner rural sex-specific geometric means anchor conditional arithmetic lipid means at age34/BMI22 using geometric_mean*exp(log_sd^2/2). Not preservation of source marginal means. Shared-source summaries not independent confirmations.
